paragraphs.en: 🧠 Start from a portfolio holding → let a nine-agent TradingAgents research team analyze it → follow the bull/bear debate and risk review → receive a PM decision memo and the complete reasoning trail in your messaging app within 3–5 minutes.
paragraphs.zh: 🧠 从一个投资组合持仓开始 → 让九个智能体组成的 TradingAgents 研究团队进行分析 → 跟踪多空辩论与风险审查 → 在 3–5 分钟内于你的即时通讯应用中收到基金经理（PM）决策备忘录及完整的推理链路。

paragraphs.en: Stock and listed ETF search, watchlists, holdings, price alerts, quotes and candlesticks share the same workflow across mainland China, Hong Kong and US markets. Search by code or name (for example, 510300 , 159915 , 02800 or SPY ). The asset type is saved with each instrument; select ETF for funds whose provider name does not identify them as ETFs.
paragraphs.zh: 股票及上市 ETF 搜索、自选清单、持仓、价格提醒、行情报价与 K 线图在中国内地、香港及美国市场共用同一套工作流程。 可按代码或名称搜索（例如 510300、159915、02800 或 SPY）。 资产类型会随每只金融工具一同保存；若基金的发行方名称无法表明其属于 ETF，请选择 ETF 类型。

paragraphs.en: ETF deep analysis uses fund-specific context and does not substitute company financial statements. Fund holdings, NAV, fees and tracking error are not yet supplied as structured data. Paper trading continues to use its existing market rules and cost model; ETF-specific T+0 exceptions and fee schedules are not modeled.
paragraphs.zh: ETF深度分析使用基金专属的上下文，不能替代公司财务报表。 基金持仓、净值（NAV）、费用及跟踪误差尚未以结构化数据的形式提供。 模拟交易继续沿用其现有市场规则和成本模型；ETF特有的T+0例外情形及费率表暂未纳入建模。

paragraphs.en: docker run -d \ --name panwatch \ --restart unless-stopped \ -e TZ=Asia/Shanghai \ -p 8000:8000 \ -v panwatch_data:/app/data \ sunxiao0721/panwatch:latest Open http://localhost:8000 and create your login credentials.

paragraphs.en: Set TZ explicitly for background schedules and notification quiet hours, for example -e TZ=UTC or -e TZ=America/New_York . The image defaults to Asia/Shanghai and does not detect the host timezone. Interface timestamps and alert expiry inputs use the browser timezone. Timezone policy
paragraphs.zh: 为后台定时任务和通知免打扰时段显式设置时区，例如 -e TZ=UTC 或 -e TZ=America/New_York 。 镜像默认使用 Asia/Shanghai，且不会检测宿主机的时区。 界面中的时间戳和告警过期时间的输入使用浏览器时区。时区策略

paragraphs.en: The image includes Playwright's system dependencies. Chromium's headless shell for screenshots is downloaded on first startup into the mounted volume (default /app/data/playwright ), which requires network access and can take a few minutes.

paragraphs.en: Select the brain icon beside a holding to start TradingAgents deep analysis. Four analyst roles feed a bull/bear debate, risk review, and portfolio-manager decision, with the reasoning trail available in the app and through configured notification channels. Runtime and cost depend on the selected models and configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 选择持仓旁边的脑形图标，即可启动 TradingAgents 深度分析。 四个分析师角色为多空辩论、风险审查和投资经理决策提供输入，推理过程可在应用内以及通过已配置的通知渠道查看。 运行时长和费用取决于所选模型和配置。

paragraphs.en: Requirements: Python 3.11+ / Node.js 24.14.0 / pnpm 9.15.9

paragraphs.en: # One-command development setup (recommended) make dev-api # Backend with automatic venv/dependencies on :8000 make dev-web # Frontend with automatic pnpm install on :5183 # Or start each service manually python -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate pip install -r requirements.txt python server.py # Backend on :8000 cd frontend && pnpm install && pnpm dev # Frontend on :5183 The frontend development server runs at http://localhost:5183 and proxies /api to 127.0.0.1:8000 .
paragraphs.zh: # 一键式开发环境配置（推荐） make dev-api # 后端，自动创建 venv/安装依赖，运行在 :8000 make dev-web # 前端，自动执行 pnpm install，运行在 :5183 # 或者手动启动各个服务 python -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate pip install -r requirements.txt python server.py # 后端运行在 :8000 cd frontend && pnpm install && pnpm dev # 前端运行在 :5183 前端开发服务器运行在 http://localhost:5183，并将 /api 代理到 127.0.0.1:8000。

paragraphs.en: PanWatch includes a built-in observability stack with structured logs, end-to-end trace_id correlation, the agent_runs table, and node-level TradingAgents progress and cost reporting. It works without any external service.
paragraphs.zh: PanWatch 内置了可观测性组件栈，包括结构化日志、端到端的 trace_id 关联、agent_runs 表，以及节点级的 TradingAgents 进度与成本报告。 它无需任何外部服务即可工作。

paragraphs.en: Premarket, intraday and postmarket all use the independently installable Pan Investment Research package . Choose validated graph templates, specialists, debate policy and per-run budgets in Research orchestration on the Agents page. Intraday uses a deterministic change gate and a short expert/decision graph; quiet snapshots use no model and preserve previous advice. Premarket adds opening scenarios; postmarket adds attribution and evidence-linked review of supplied premarket plans.
paragraphs.zh: 盘前、盘中与盘后均使用可独立安装的 Pan Investment Research 软件包。 在「智能体」页面的研究编排（Research orchestration）中，选择经过验证的图模板、专家、辩论策略以及每次运行预算。 盘中使用确定性的变更门控和简短的专家/决策图；平静快照不使用模型，并保留之前的建议。 盘前增加开盘情景；盘后增加归因分析以及对所提供盘前计划的、带证据链接的复盘。

sents.en: Premarket, intraday and postmarket all use the independently installable Pan Investment Research package .
sents.zh: 盘前、盘中与盘后均使用可独立安装的 Pan Investment Research 软件包。

sents.en: Choose validated graph templates, specialists, debate policy and per-run budgets in Research orchestration on the Agents page.
sents.zh: 在「智能体」页面的研究编排（Research orchestration）中，选择经过验证的图模板、专家、辩论策略以及每次运行预算。

sents.en: Intraday uses a deterministic change gate and a short expert/decision graph; quiet snapshots use no model and preserve previous advice.
sents.zh: 盘中使用确定性的变更门控和简短的专家/决策图；平静快照不使用模型，并保留之前的建议。

sents.en: Premarket adds opening scenarios; postmarket adds attribution and evidence-linked review of supplied premarket plans.
sents.zh: 盘前增加开盘情景；盘后增加归因分析以及对所提供盘前计划的、带证据链接的复盘。

paragraphs.en: Market models do not receive account cash. Mandatory execution rules apply account and quote restrictions after market research. Migration v139 retires the old legacy/shadow execution modes while preserving settings and history. The three old session prompts and text parsers are removed; TradingAgents deep analysis remains independent.
paragraphs.zh: 市场模型不会收到账户资金。 强制执行规则在市场研究之后应用账户和报价限制。 迁移 v139 在保留设置和历史记录的同时，弃用了旧的 legacy/shadow 执行模式。 三个旧的会话提示词和文本解析器已被移除；TradingAgents 深度分析保持独立。

sents.en: Market models do not receive account cash.
sents.zh: 市场模型不会收到账户资金。

sents.en: Mandatory execution rules apply account and quote restrictions after market research.
sents.zh: 强制执行规则在市场研究之后应用账户和报价限制。

sents.en: Migration v139 retires the old legacy/shadow execution modes while preserving settings and history.
sents.zh: 迁移 v139 在保留设置和历史记录的同时，弃用了旧的 legacy/shadow 执行模式。

sents.en: The three old session prompts and text parsers are removed; TradingAgents deep analysis remains independent.
sents.zh: 三个旧的会话提示词和文本解析器已被移除；TradingAgents 深度分析保持独立。

paragraphs.en: Premarket and postmarket analyze all bound stocks together, sharing specialists within groups and running portfolio strategy, risk and finalization once. Evidence details support batch reads across stocks. Default context, output and token capacities adjust to target count; explicit global caps remain effective, and time and concurrency limits do not grow with the watchlist.
paragraphs.zh: 盘前和盘后阶段将所有绑定的股票合并分析，在组内共享智能体，并一次性运行组合策略、风险与最终定稿。 证据详情支持跨股票的批量读取。 默认上下文、输出和 token 容量会根据目标数量进行调整；显式全局上限仍然有效，而时间与并发限制不会随观察列表增长。

sents.en: Premarket and postmarket analyze all bound stocks together, sharing specialists within groups and running portfolio strategy, risk and finalization once.
sents.zh: 盘前和盘后阶段将所有绑定的股票合并分析，在组内共享智能体，并一次性运行组合策略、风险与最终定稿。

sents.en: Evidence details support batch reads across stocks.
sents.zh: 证据详情支持跨股票的批量读取。

sents.en: Default context, output and token capacities adjust to target count; explicit global caps remain effective, and time and concurrency limits do not grow with the watchlist.
sents.zh: 默认上下文、输出和 token 容量会根据目标数量进行调整；显式全局上限仍然有效，而时间与并发限制不会随观察列表增长。

paragraphs.en: Model candidates and read-only evidence tools share explicit attempt, token, concurrency and time limits. Unresolved objections or exhausted budgets mark research incomplete and retain only validated strategy drafts; no watch suggestion is fabricated when no strategy finished. Completed graph artifacts, normalized suggestions, prediction tracking and delivery claims commit atomically; incomplete research does not publish formal suggestions or prediction outcomes. Unknown notification acknowledgements are recorded without blind replay. Cross-process graph resumption and automatic outbox recovery are not enabled. This research output does not place orders or establish verified buying power.
paragraphs.zh: 模型候选与只读证据工具共享明确的尝试次数、令牌、并发和时间限制。 未解决的异议或耗尽的预算会将研究标记为未完成，仅保留已验证的策略草案；当没有策略完成时，不会虚构观察建议。 已完成的图工件、规范化的建议、预测跟踪和交付声明原子性地提交；未完成的研究不会发布正式建议或预测结果。 未知的通知确认会被记录，而不会盲目重放。 跨进程的图恢复和自动发件箱恢复未启用。 本研究结果不下达订单，也不建立已验证的购买力。

sents.zh: 模型候选与只读证据工具共享明确的尝试次数、令牌、并发和时间限制。
